pictures.name: HS1-Two-Schools
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Inside an ancient stone study house in the land of Israel, with scroll shelves, low benches and oil lamps: two groups of students in robes sit facing each other across the room, open scrolls between them. In the middle, a young student of Hillel in a pale sand-colored robe with a short brown beard and a young student of Shammai in a dark olive robe with a black beard lean toward each other, mid-argument, passionate but respectful. Two elder teachers sit far in the background, small and indistinct. Warm lamplight, deep blue shadows.
